text.en: Pet owners consistently praise the kindness, attentiveness, and patience of the salon team, often highlighting Carlos for his accommodating care. Reviewers appreciate that the staff never rush appointments and maintain high standards across repeat visits, creating a welcoming and calm environment for every pet.

Clients emphasize the loving and patient treatment their dogs receive throughout each grooming session. Multiple pet owners note that their dogs return home happy and relaxed rather than stressed, demonstrating real trust in the team. Regular visitors value that groomers treat each animal with genuine personal affection.

Pet parents express strong satisfaction with the grooming results, pointing out that dogs leave looking immaculate, clean, and beautifully styled. Reviewers mention that coat trims and bath finishes are done with great attention to detail, leaving pets smelling fresh and looking their best after every appointment.

q.en: Does Princess and Dukes Pet Salon accept walk-in clients?

a.en: Yes, clients report that the salon accommodates walk-ins for grooming and quick maintenance needs.

q.en: How do reviewers describe the staff handling of pets?

a.en: Pet owners report that staff members treat dogs with great patience and genuine affection, never rushing the process.

q.en: Does the salon offer pickup and delivery services?

a.en: Yes, the salon provides local pet pickup and delivery services in addition to standard in-salon appointments.

q.en: Where is Princess and Dukes Pet Salon located?

a.en: The salon is located on West 32nd Avenue in Hialeah, serving local dogs and pet families.
